mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE lineage(id,parent_id,depth,path,valid) AS ( SELECT d.id,d.parent_id,1,ARRAY[d.id::text],d.enabled FROM c2k_member_department m JOIN c2k_department d ON d.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND d.id=m.department_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{${tenantParameter}} AND m.member_id=${memberExpression} UNION ALL SELECT d.id,d.parent_id,l.depth+1,l.path || d.id::text,l.valid AND d.enabled FROM lineage l JOIN c2k_department d ON d.tenant_id=#{${tenantParameter}} AND d.id=l.parent_id WHERE l.depth < 16 AND NOT d.id=ANY(l.path) ) SELECT 1 FROM lineage l JOIN c2k_department_grant dg ON dg.tenant_id=#{${tenantParameter}} AND dg.department_id=l.id WHERE l.valid AND dg.active AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lineage bad WHERE NOT bad.valid) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lineage root WHERE root.parent_id IS NULL) AND (l.depth=1 OR dg.include_children) AND dg.resource_kind=${kind} AND dg.resource_id=s.id AND dg.source_revision=${version}
mapper.select: SELECT id,COALESCE(parent_id,'') AS parent_id,name,sort_order,enabled,revision FROM c2k_department WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} ORDER BY sort_order,name,id LIMIT 501

SELECT a.id AS member_id, COALESCE(m.department_id, '') AS department_id FROM c2k_account a LEFT JOIN c2k_member_department m ON m.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND m.member_id = a.id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenant} ORDER BY a.username, a.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM c2k_department WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM c2k_department WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND parent_id=#{id}) + (SELECT count(*) FROM c2k_member_department WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND department_id=#{id}) + (SELECT count(*) FROM c2k_department_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND department_id=#{id} AND active)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_member_department(tenant_id,member_id,department_id,revision) VALUES(#{tenant},#{member},NULLIF(#{department},''),#{revision}+1) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,member_id) DO UPDATE SET department_id=EXCLUDED.department_id,revision=EXCLUDED.revision
mapper.select: SELECT department_id,resource_kind,resource_id,source_revision,include_children,active,revision FROM c2k_department_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND resource_kind=#{kind} AND resource_id=#{resource} ORDER BY department_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO c2k_department_grant(tenant_id,department_id,resource_kind,resource_id,source_revision,include_children,revision,active) VALUES(#{tenant},#{input.departmentId},#{kind},#{resource},#{input.sourceRevision},#{input.includeChildren},#{input.revision}+1,true) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,department_id,resource_kind,resource_id) DO UPDATE SET source_revision=EXCLUDED.source_revision,include_children=EXCLUDED.include_children,revision=EXCLUDED.revision,active=true
